lines.text: The root is Spect! Suspect, prospect.
Did you know? Spect is Latin for look.
Suspect: up from under plus look.
Quick quiz! Which means forward plus look?

words.mean: look up from under, so doubt
words.ex: I suspect he forgot about the meeting.
The prospect of a long journey didn't excite me.
